source: RareTopo-M3-D-v1 classifier, extracted from configs/phase_m3d/m3d_reference_characterization.json and src/hyptraj/m3d/reference_direction.py
paired_se_method: SE of 20 paired CRN batch differences

rules.WIDEN: M2(widen)/M2(base)-1 < -0.01 AND M2(widen) < M2(shrink), both required base contrasts supported, direction margin >= 0.05
rules.SHRINK: M2(shrink)/M2(base)-1 < -0.01 AND M2(shrink) < M2(widen), both required base contrasts supported, direction margin >= 0.05
rules.HOLD: neither improvement rule applies AND both arm/base relative differences have absolute value <= 0.03
rules.AMBIGUOUS: unsupported required contrast, failed direction margin, or no unique WIDEN/HOLD/SHRINK class
rules.INVALID: probability gate fail, non-finite arithmetic, illegal proposal, sample/draw mismatch, or ESS below 20

tie_handling: ties that do not satisfy the unique preregistered class remain AMBIGUOUS
